name: ithrl-v02-m1-step1
revision: Before sensitivity execution, corrected outcome-dependent validity to apply conditional mutant rate 1/3 to every mutant independently of location/components. Qualification parameters and default simulation law are unchanged. Conditional-rate declarations in that sensitivity are not evidence of an unconditional effect.
scope: credential-free design study; no native or provider execution

confirmation.method: independent one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds, union allocation

attempt_ceiling: n + ceil(n/2) + 6 per arm; calibration n=3 A=7

discovery.selection: first screen-passing location; one final artifact, no holdout reselection

mutation.family: append four explicitly synthetic stale/irrelevant paragraphs to a copied prior user text field
mutation.duplicate_text_family: no-effect control; no native equivalence assumed
mutation.simplification: remove whole added paragraphs in order, restart on acceptance; deduplicate by location and remaining mask; empty intervention refused without dispatch

workflow_meaning.adaptive-shrink: calibrate, screen four locations, simplify first hit, fresh final original/mutant comparison
workflow_meaning.sweep-unshrunk: calibrate, same four-location screens, fresh confirmation of first hit without simplification
workflow_meaning.direct-unshrunk: calibrate then confirm one prespecified location chosen uniformly; no discovery or shrinking

qualification.complete_workflow_success: calibration, discovery, completed simplification, >=50% irrelevant mutation bytes removed, all essential components retained, fresh eligible confirmed decrease
qualification.multiplicity_family: all 27 adaptive designs x 4 invalid rates x (4 locations x 4 single components + 6 two-component interactions at location 0)
qualification.runtime_choice: lowest mean attempted calls among designs passing every single-component location/invalid-rate gate; prefer smaller maximum allowance then lower confirm n on ties
qualification.interaction_gate: report separately; require >=0.8 simultaneous lower bound for all six pairs before including interactions in supported study envelope
qualification.cost_acceptance: at most 512 calls admitted, compared with 293-observation prior reduction anchor; <=512 is an explicit first-study budget bracket, not a subscription allowance or immutable product limit
qualification.cost_interpretation: report all-run mean/p50/p95/max, incomplete rates, confirmed rate and simplified-confirmed rate; do not condition spending on success

operating_characteristics.definition: actual D=max(0, delta+offset), retain only p_mutant=p_original-D in [0,1]; enumerate all count pairs

sensitivity.null_campaigns: all locations unchanged, including duplication control; screen/simplify can select false hits, final comparison remains fresh
sensitivity.candidate_dependent_validity: original valid probability .95, mutant .80; conditional target rates held fixed, assess completion and conditional inference
sensitivity.outcome_dependent_validity: both unconditional target probabilities .50; original accepts matches with 1 and nonmatches with .50, mutant accepts matches with .50 and nonmatches with 1; resulting conditional rates 2/3 and 1/3
sensitivity.time_drift: equal underlying response function .9 to .5 across confirmation block, shuffled arm labels; record assumption violation and empirical declarations without claiming iid coverage

decisions.go: at least one feasible complete-workflow design passes prospective single-component utility gates; exact rule/reference validation passes; one safe text overlay seam demonstrated purely
decisions.course_correct: if no design passes, compare a simpler generation/simplification schedule or revise the supported scenario prospectively; do not enter production contracts merely because infrastructure exists
decisions.open: native effect size/usefulness and exact practical duration still require later approved execution
